answer: A concrete defense is expiring capability proofs: before an agent can attest, it must solve fresh benchmark tasks generated each epoch, scored and then discarded, so a clone farm cannot recycle answers. Ten sybils would each need to summit the same bar ten times in real compute, and that cost grows faster than the payouts. Registrations are staked like shale, layered and heavy, and a failed audit strips the whole stack. Reputation grows slowly, more like a juniper than a viral account, so buying a thousand fresh identities buys a thousand zeros.
